tool.title: List branches (GitHub)
tool.description: List the branch names of the current checkout's GitHub project, as the forge reports them.

selection.when: The change proposals live on GitHub — the checkout's remote is a GitHub project.
selection.limits: GitHub only. For a GitLab project use `gitlab-branches`.
selection.cost: `gh`, authenticated (`gh auth login` or `GH_TOKEN`), and one API round trip per call.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitHub API another way. A session that provides the GitHub MCP server can use it instead.

$comment.comment:
`{owner}` and `{repo}` are gh's own placeholders, filled by gh from the
current checkout's remote. They are words gh reads, not a template this
harness substitutes: no Tool input reaches them.
